text: Added table metadata and project summary support in shared scalafim-bids: BidsColumn for safe typed column access, BidsTableContext/BidsTableFile for path/entity metadata attachment, BidsProject subject/session/task/run summaries, and JVM readEventTableFiles/readConfoundTableFiles while preserving tuple-returning methods. Updated docs. Verification: sbt bidsJVM/test bidsJS/test passed 34 JVM / 30 JS tests; sbt compileAll passed; sbt testAll passed.
